subject: História
description_pt: Identificar as hipóteses científicas sobre o surgimento da espécie humana e sua historicidade e analisar os significados dos mitos de fundação.

components.description_pt: Identificar hipóteses científicas sobre o surgimento e historicidade da espécie humana
components.description_en: Identify scientific hypotheses about the emergence and historicity of the human species
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the validity of hypotheses presented in a science or technical text

components.description_pt: Analisar os significados e funções de mitos fundadores sobre as origens humanas
components.description_en: Analyze the meanings and functions of founding myths about human origins

components.description_pt: Comparar explicações científicas com mitos fundadores sobre a origem dos seres humanos
components.description_en: Compare scientific explanations with founding myths regarding the origin of human beings

components.description_pt: Distinguir entre abordagens científicas e mitológicas para explicar as origens humanas
components.description_en: Distinguish between scientific and mythological approaches to explaining human origins
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between empirically testable questions and those that require non-scientific approaches

cc_matches.description: Ask questions that require sufficient and appropriate empirical evidence to answer.

Evaluate the hypotheses, data, analysis, and conclusions in a science or technical text, verifying the data when possible and corroborating or challenging conclusions with other sources of information.
